sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and fixed-address rule
sections.what: Brings in navigation, the not-found helper, the room lookup, the sport and room types, and display pieces such as badges and charts. It also sets the route to accept only rooms that were built ahead of time.
sections.why: Likely reason: the fixed-address setting means unknown addresses get a not-found page rather than an empty room.
sections.watch_out: Only rooms listed at build time can open, so a new room needs a rebuild before it appears.

sections.name: generateStaticParams
sections.title: List of rooms to build ahead
sections.what: Tells the build step every room that exists, using each room's sport and short name, so each room page is created in advance.
sections.why: Likely reason: pages built ahead of time load quickly, and unknown room addresses are rejected.
sections.watch_out: A room missing from the room service will not get a page.

sections.name: generateMetadata, SPORT, over
sections.title: Tab title and display helpers
sections.what: Sets the browser tab title to the room's name, or Event Room if the room is unknown. Also holds the sport display names and a helper that turns a ball count into over and ball notation, so seven balls shows as 1.1.
sections.why: Likely reason: cricket fans read overs in this format, so the helper converts ball counts into it.
sections.watch_out: The sport name table has no entries for basketball or tennis, so a room for those sports would show a blank heading.

sections.name: EventRoomPage
sections.title: Room page layout
sections.what: Looks up the room and shows a not-found page if it is missing. Otherwise it shows the room header and badges, then three panels: win probability with its chart and model name, leverage with a meter and its peak value, and stories. A line at the bottom gives the data attribution. Where the model is missing, the panels show a short reason instead.
sections.why: Likely reason: each panel shows whether its data exists, so gaps are explained and not hidden.
sections.watch_out: The leverage meter divides the value by 0.5, so it assumes 0.5 is the largest possible value, and a change to that definition would draw the meter wrong.

summary: Detail page for one recorded match room, showing win probability, leverage, and stories, or explaining why they are missing.
purpose: Shows a single recorded event room.
why: Visitors browse rooms to see how a recorded match's chances moved over time. The page is built ahead of time.
how: Steps in order: the route accepts only rooms that were built ahead of time. It looks up the room by sport and event name, and shows a not-found page if it does not exist. It then draws the header with its badges, the win probability chart with its model name, the leverage meter with its peak value, and a list of stories. Each part carries a receipt showing its source. If no model exists, the panels show a short reason instead.
inputs: The sport and event parts of the web address, and room data from the rooms service.
outputs: The room page with charts and lists, or a not-found page.
risks: The sport name table has no entries for basketball or tennis. The leverage meter assumes 0.5 is the largest value. The historical replay label is fixed text.
debug: If a room shows not found, check the room list and rebuild the site. If a title is missing, check the room name and the sport name table. If the win probability chart is missing, check the room's model data. If the meter looks wrong, check the leverage value.
